meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. No pattern hits. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

pii_scan.disposition: Business and agency contact details only; no private-person data expected. Safe for local evaluation use.

rules.paraphrase: The time for each activity must be separately stated; block billing is not acceptable.
Each billing entry includes date, description, timekeeper, time spent and charge.
Time is recorded daily in tenth-hour increments and multiple tasks of six minutes or less are grouped under one tenth.

params.not_to_exceed: lowest rate charged to any other public sector client

rules.paraphrase: Rate must not exceed the lowest charged to any public sector client and there is no minimum charge for calls or file review.

keywords: preparing for or attending events by more than one person without approval

rules.paraphrase: No payment for basic research, court-rule research, transition time, internal conferences or duplicate attendance.
No more than one partner and one associate on a matter without approval; staffing changes need advance approval.
Out-of-town travel time is paid at half the regular rate unless actively working on the matter.
Computerized research and overhead are not billable; expenses are itemised with receipts; coach air fare only and no alcohol.

params.unit: nature, purpose or subject of work readily ascertained

rules.paraphrase: Descriptions must show the nature, purpose or subject of the work and the specific task.
No payment above the approved budget without an updated written approval.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Each bill is reviewed, approved and initialled by the lead attorney.
An initial report is due within 45 days and status reports every 90 days.
